name: USDU Finance
oneLiner: USDU is USDU Finance's DAO-minted dollar backed by Morpho and Curve vault shares after a sharp supply wind-down.
collateral: Adapter-held positions: Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens, Morpho USDU Core vault shares (curated lending), and TermMax USDU vault shares (fixed-term lending) as on-chain backing
pegMechanism: Protocol-minted via DAO-approved adapters; convertible to USDC via Curve pools

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: USDU resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer API reports 34,938.881009 USDU-equivalent in the Morpho adapter and 22,684.146395 in the Curve adapter, with negligible TermMax backing. At Ethereum block 25530488, the Curve pool held 30,869.816267 USDC and 19,226.470521 USDU. Splitting the API-valued Curve position by those constituent balances and normalizing to total backing yields 60.6% Morpho USDU self-exposure, 15.1% Curve USDU self-exposure, and 24.3% external USDC collateral.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: USDU issuer backing API with an on-chain constituent split of the Curve LP position
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All positive adapter backing is classified; USDU-denominated vault and LP positions are retained as self-reserve rather than false upstream dependencies.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The Morpho vault represents lending positions denominated in the subject USDU asset and cannot create a dependency edge to itself.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The subject-token leg of the Curve LP is self exposure rather than an upstream stablecoin dependency.

notices.title: Post-wind-down collateral coverage
notices.message: USDU Finance's transparency page currently reports roughly 100% collateralization after a sharp supply wind-down, with backing concentrated in Morpho USDU Core vault shares and Curve USDU/USDC LP tokens.

notices.title: Conflicting issuer disclosures
notices.message: USDU Finance's live transparency endpoint now reports backing approximately equal to circulating supply after the wind-down. Treat exact collateralization and allocation figures as live-snapshot values because supply and adapter balances have moved materially.

mintAuthority.summary: USDU cannot be minted by users directly; only DAO-approved/whitelisted adapter contracts (Curve, TermMax, Morpho) can mint or burn USDU, and the set of approved adapters is curated under USDU Finance DAO risk governance.

controls.label: Whitelisted USDU adapters (Curve / TermMax / Morpho)
controls.evidence: USDU Finance docs/transparency state users cannot mint USDU directly; only whitelisted adapters can mint/burn USDU while executing their strategy, with each adapter holding the on-chain backing assets.

controls.label: USDU DAO / curator (adapter whitelist authority)
controls.evidence: The DAO/curator governs adapter approval and risk parameters, controlling which contracts hold mint/burn rights; published as core token/DAO/adapter contracts on Ethereum.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295203: USDU token verified as 'Stablecoin' contract on Blockscout with curator/guardian/module model. curator() returned 0x9fe66037… (ERC1967Proxy → DAO implementation contract). guardian() returned zero address (no guardian set). Token owner() reverted (no Ownable). ABI shows mintModule(address,uint256) / burnModule(address,uint256) — only whitelisted modules can mint/burn. The specific set of approved modules was not enumerable from ABI; module(address) takes an address argument and no enumeration function was found. Curator is a DAO contract (upgradeable proxy); its internal governance (token holders, timelock) was not fully resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate the current approved modules (adapter contracts) that hold mintModule rights — no on-chain enumeration function found; requires event log scan or docs cross-check.
Resolve internal governance of the DAO curator (0x9fe66037): token-based voting, multisig, or EOA admin.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDU is protocol-issued against managed stablecoin and stablecoin-liquidity positions rather than overcollateralized borrower vaults.
